## Grizzly Bear Rug (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
N Large animal  
**Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +6  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +6  natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 65 (5d8+25)  
**Fort** +8, **Ref** +5, **Will** +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +7 (1d6+5 plus grab), bite +7 (1d6+5)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** Grizzly bear rugs remain motionless, using freeze to catch opponents unawares.  

 **During Combat** Quite focused, these creatures relentlessly assault one enemy before engaging the next foe.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 21, **Dex** 13, **Con** 19, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +8 (+12 grapple); **CMD** 19 (23 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Run, Skill Focus (Survival)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness.*  
**Skills** Perception +6, Stealth +1  
**SQ** compression, freeze  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or carpet (3-8)  
**Treasure** none
